license.adaptation_notice: This project merges v20/v90 name-only character records and adds separately identified project display names.

license_retrieval.statement: All information on VNDB is made available under the Open Database License. Any rights in individual contents of the database are licensed under the Database Contents License.
license_retrieval.relevant_exception: Images, visual novel descriptions and character descriptions are gathered from various online sources and may be subject to separate license conditions. None of these fields are requested or included.

api.usage_terms: Free for non-commercial use; best-effort service; subject to VNDB data license and API rate limits.
api.query_scope: Per-title VN filters for v20 and v90; only name,original,aliases fields; complete paginated results sorted by stable ID.
api.initial_retrieval_note: The web-reader requests for VNDB pages returned HTTP 503; direct Python urllib Kana POST requests succeeded. Direct urllib GET also retrieved the licensing page.

style_reference.observed_policy: Ittaku retains Japanese honorifics and places given names first in English.
style_reference.use_limit: Style evidence only. Project display spellings are editorial decisions from the VNDB names, not a claim of script-level verification against Ittaku.
